statutory_frameworks.official_title: Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act of 2022 (CIRCIA)

metadata.covered_entities: Covered critical infrastructure across all 16 PPD-21 sectors

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Executive Order 14028: Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity

metadata.mandates: NIST SSDF compliance, mandatory Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for federal procurement

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Consolidated Appropriations Act 2023, Section 524B: Ensuring Cybersecurity of Medical Devices

metadata.mandates: Refusal to accept medical device 510(k) or PMA submissions lacking complete SBOM, vulnerability disclosure, and post-market patch plan

statutory_frameworks.official_title: CISA Binding Operational Directive 22-01: Reducing the Significant Risk of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 as amended by California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA)

cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: NIST SP 800-161r1 supply chain risk assessment; CMMC 2.0 Level 2/3 third-party assessment for defense industrial base
cyber_security_mandates.details: Strict compliance with CISA KEV timeline (14-21 days); NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) attestation required on CISA Form.

data_privacy_sovereignty.primary_privacy_law: Sectoral Federal (HIPAA, GLBA, COPPA) + 18 State Omnibus Laws (CCPA, VCDPA, CPA, CTDPA, etc.)
data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: No federal omnibus localization. International Data Transfer Executive Order 14117 restricts transfer of bulk sensitive personal data to countries of concern (China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Venezuela).
data_privacy_sovereignty.cross_border_transfer_mechanism: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (Adequacy), Contractual Safeguards, OECD Principles

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) 15 CFR Part 774, Commerce Control List Category 5 Part 2 (Information Security). Licence Exception ENC.
cryptography_controls.approved_encryption_standards: FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules, AES-GCM (128/256), SHA-2/SHA-3, CNSA 2.0 Quantum-Resistant Algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: National Security Memorandum 10 (NSM-10) and OMB M-23-02: Federal agencies and critical infrastructure contractors must complete cryptographic discovery (CBOM) and transition firmware to post-quantum algorithms by 2030-2033.
cryptography_controls.regulatory_agency: Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) / NIST

incident_disclosure_rules.breach_type: Covered Cyber Incident in Critical Infrastructure
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: CIRCIA: Any substantial cyber incident affecting covered critical infrastructure, or payment of any ransom within 24 hours of disbursement.

recipient_authorities: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05)
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Item 1.05 of Form 8-K: Determination that a cybersecurity incident experienced by the registrant is material.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.

Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
